completed_automated_actions.description: All 5 PI-only fields identified and documented with character limits and instructions
6 institution fields (SO identity, IT Director, IRB assurance, data destruction, eRA Commons) documented
All required DAR components enumerated: DUC, IRB approval, IT security plan, data destruction plan, CTEP notification
Email target confirmed: NCICTEPDAR@mail.nih.gov. Template: subject must match project_title exactly. Body must include study accession phs003428, PI name, institution, intended use.
Confirmed: institution must be registered in eRA Commons before DAR submission. Registration is institution-level (not PI-level) — requires SO action.

human_only_blockers.action_required: PI emails NCICTEPDAR@mail.nih.gov BEFORE submitting DAR. Must receive approval response. Upload approval email as ctep_notification_attachment.
PI-authored scientific narrative (max 2000 chars). Cannot be machine-generated — must reflect PI's specific research intent.
Signing Official at PI's institution must cosign the DAR. Requires institutional coordination.
IRB approval or exemption letter for use of phs003428 data. Must be uploaded.

no_further_automation_possible.reason: All remaining steps require human authorship (research_use_statement, non_technical_summary), institutional signatures (SO, IRB), or government email exchange (CTEP pre-notification). No additional DAR fields can be pre-populated by machine without PI-specific research intent and institutional credentials.
